Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm was facing a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The farm had paused paid apprenticeships, cut staff hours and launched a $200,000 fundraising campaign. It grows about 30,000 pounds of produce annually and helps feed 700 families a week.
